# awm

> A portable, scoped agent memory.

An agent that forgets everything between sessions re-derives the same facts forever; one that remembers everything globally leaks context across projects.

## Install

```
pip install awm
```

## In Claude Code

- mcp: `awm mcp`
- hook: `awm recall --claude-hook` (on SessionStart)

## Use it in 30 seconds

Give one agent a memory scoped to one project and watch it stop re-asking.

## Composes with

- [awpredict](https://aitherium.github.io/awpredict/) — Predict what your environment does next, and how surprised you were.
- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awgraph](https://aitherium.github.io/awgraph/) — A semantic code graph for agents — AST + tree-sitter, call graphs.
- [awembed](https://aitherium.github.io/awembed/) — Train an embedding model that knows your corpus, and prove it beats the big one.
